Overview

This feature service provides a municipal parks layer for developed parks in Peachland, British Columbia. It supports viewing and managing park locations and related park records for local planning, operations, and public information.

Feature Layers

  • Parks (PCH) — A polygon feature layer representing developed parks in Peachland. The layer includes park naming and identifier information, status details.

Geographic Coverage

The service covers the District of Peachland area within the Regional District of Central Okanagan in British Columbia, Canada.

Use Cases

  • Municipal parks inventory and maintenance planning
  • Asset and land management reference
  • Public-facing park location mapping
  • Supporting local planning and parks administration workflows

Access and Licensing

Owned by District of Peachland, published by the GIS Section of the Regional District of Central Okanagan for Peachland and provided under the Regional District of Central Okanagan open data license and related terms of use.
